resources.string: Sweep runs inside Android System WebView and needs version %1$d or newer. This phone has version %2$d.\n\nUpdate Android System WebView (on some phones it comes with Chrome) from your app store, or install your phone\'s latest system update, then open Sweep again.
Sweep runs inside Android System WebView, and this phone doesn\'t have a working one. It may be turned off in your phone\'s app settings, or it may need an update from your app store.

Google\'s last security fixes for Android 9 came out in January 2022, so holes in Android found since then stay open on this phone. Sweep checks installed apps and their settings, and spyware that got in through one of those holes might not show up as an app. On a phone this old, what Sweep finds tells you less than it would on a newer one.
